text:
lina: FYI customer reported a big delta between Dashboard usage and invoice for embeddings + rerank on account acct_84X. Dashboard shows ~3.2M embed units, invoice lists ~12.6M. They only started a week ago.

daniel: can you paste the raw API calls they made (sample request + batch sizes)? often this is batch vs pairwise accounting.

lina: here's the snippet they provided (redacted):

```
POST /v1/embeddings
Authorization: Bearer sk-CUSTOMER
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "model": "redwood-embed-XL",
  "input": ["doc1","doc2",...,"doc50"],
  "rerank": {"method": "pairwise", "batch": true}
}
```

lina: they were sending 50 inputs per request with pairwise rerank enabled. they claim dashboard shows per-input accounting but invoice seems to reflect pairwise calculations.

ori: @lina can you pull the per-request metering export for acct_84X for the date range and attach the CSV? I want to compare token columns: embed_tokens vs rerank_pairwise_ops.

lina: attached CSV snippet: "request_id,inputs,embed_units,rerank_ops"
"r1,50,5000,1225"
"r2,48,4800,1128"

zara-billing: metric-bot flagged lots of rerank_ops last week, see auto-alert: "metric-bot: high-rerank-pairwise-ops acct_84X 2026-03-02 -> +380%". Invoice engine bills rerank_ops as separate units. Dashboard currently surfaces embed_units by default which hid the rerank spike.

daniel: got it. so two issues: 1) pairwise rerank is O(n^2) so 50 inputs => 1225 pairs which explains the multiplier; 2) dashboard UX default view omitted rerank pairwise metric so customer didn't notice.

ori: repro steps for SRE/dev: run a local batch with 50 inputs and pairwise rerank to verify counts. quick curl to reproduce: 
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEV_KEY" -d '{"model":"redwood-embed-XL","input":["a","b",... repeated 50],"rerank":{"method":"pairwise"}}' https://api.redwood.com/v1/embeddings
```
check /internal/metering/logs for fields: embed_units, pairwise_comparisons, tokens_processed.

lina: customer also reported truncated inputs — some docs got length-limited which changed token estimates per input. could be extra retries too (they had 3xx retry spikes).

zara-billing: I created billing ticket BILL-2026-284 and asked for provisional credit while we validate. please include the per-request CSV and the invoice id INV-2026-77.

daniel: action items: (1) Eng-ML to confirm pairwise ops accounting logic (is it billed per comparison or per token-per-comparison?), (2) DevEx to add rerank_pairwise metric to Dashboard default and flag when pairwise mode is used, (3) Support to send repro to customer and confirm if they intended pairwise mode.

ori: quick note — if the model falls back to a different embedding dim (e.g., 1024->1536) because of a model variant mismatch, cost per embedding can change. confirm model name in their requests.

lina: customer confirmed they didn't intend pairwise; they thought `rerank: true` was idempotent per input. i'll follow up with a clear explanation and the provisional credit notice.

zara-billing: closing loop — billing will hold adjustment until eng confirms exact math, but provisional credit issued for the overage portion flagged by metric-bot. recorded in BILL-2026-284.

metric-bot: automated note: metering-export available at /internal/exports/acct_84X/2026-03-01_to_2026-03-07.csv (redacted link).

lina: thanks everyone. will update thread once ENG confirms pairwise billing computation and we get a UI followup ticket. :thumbsup:
